paragraphs: Wynn Resorts, Limited ("Wynn Resorts," "Wynn," or together with its subsidiaries, "we" or the "Company") is a preeminent designer, developer, and operator of integrated resorts featuring luxury hotel rooms, high-end retail space, an array of dining and entertainment options, meeting and convention facilities, and gaming, all supported by an unparalleled focus on our guests, our people, and our community. We believe that our extensive design and operational experience across numerous gaming jurisdictions provides us with a distinct advantage over other gaming enterprises.

Through our approximately 72% ownership of Wynn Macau, Limited ("WML"), we operate two integrated resorts in the Macau Special Administrative Region of the People's Republic of China ("Macau"), Wynn Palace and Wynn Macau (collectively, our "Macau Operations"). In Las Vegas, Nevada, we operate and, with the exception of certain retail space, own 100% of Wynn Las Vegas and Encore at Wynn Las Vegas, which we also refer to as our Las Vegas Operations. In Everett, Massachusetts, we operate Encore Boston Harbor, an integrated resort. Additionally, the Company has a 40% equity interest in Island 3 AMI FZ-LLC, an unconsolidated affiliate, which is constructing an integrated resort property ("Wynn Al Marjan Island") in Ras Al Khaimah, United Arab Emirates, currently expected to open in 2027.

Our annual reports on Form 10-K, quarterly reports on Form 10-Q, current reports on Form 8-K and all other reports and any amendments of such reports filed with or furnished to the Securities and Exchange Commission ("SEC") are available, without charge, at the SEC's website at http://www.sec.gov. In addition, through our corporate website at www.wynnresorts.com, Wynn Resorts provides a hyperlink to a third-party SEC filing website which makes available all such reports and amendments as soon as reasonably practicable after filing with, or furnishing to the SEC, without charge. The information found on or linked through our website is not incorporated by reference into this Annual Report on Form 10-K, nor does it form a part of this Annual Report on Form 10-K or any other report we file with or furnish to the SEC.

We conceptualize, design, build, and operate our resorts to create unforgettable customer experiences across a diverse set of gaming and non-gaming amenities that attract a wide range of customer segments and generate strong financial results.

Central to our strategy is the construction of, and regular reinvestment in, world-class integrated resorts. These activities are led by our in-house design, development, and construction subsidiary and its senior management team, which has significant experience across all major design and construction disciplines. In addition, we believe superior customer service is the best marketing strategy to attract customers and drive repeat visitation to our resorts. Human resources and staff training are essential to ensuring our employees are prepared to provide the luxury service that our guests expect. We have been successful in attracting a wide range of premium guests both domestically and internationally. Part of this strategy includes leveraging our marketing team across various branch offices located internationally to connect and build relationships with our customers. We continually evaluate our offerings and service levels, and as a result, have made and expect to continue to make enhancements and refinements to our resorts.

We continue to seek out new opportunities to develop and operate world-class integrated resorts and related businesses around the world. Overall, we believe Wynn Resorts has a demonstrated track record of developing and operating integrated resorts that stimulate local and regional economic activity, by attracting a wide range of customers (including high-net-worth international tourists), driving international tourism, raising average hotel room rates in the region, extending the average length of stay per visitor, complementing existing convention and meeting business with five-star accommodations and appropriately scaled meeting amenities, elevating service levels with the execution of five-star customer service, and stimulating city-wide investment and employment.
Wynn Resorts thrives in the luxury hospitality industry because of our employees, who exhibit our values at every level within the Company. Our values are embodied by the following concepts:
•Service-Driven. We foster a culture of respect, gratitude and meticulous attention to detail that makes service to guests our life's work.
•Excellence. Our singular focus on being the best celebrates the inherent connection between employee and guest, company and community.
•Artistry. We provide a collection of guest experiences that prize artistry and championship craftsmanship, resulting in Wynn Resorts being the highest ranked hotel company in the world.
•Progressive. Our commitment to innovation enables us to continue evolving what it means to create and operate world-class resort destinations.
Our Commitment to Corporate Social Responsibility
We are committed to our people, our communities, and our planet. Executing on our commitment to corporate social responsibility includes:
•Investing in the growth and well-being of our people.

headings: Investigations, litigation and other disputes could distract management, damage our reputation, and result in negative publicity and additional scrutiny from regulators.
We depend on the continued services of key managers and employees. If we do not retain our key personnel or attract and retain other highly skilled employees, our business will suffer.
Our continued success depends on our ability to maintain the reputation of our resorts.
We are entirely dependent on a limited number of resorts for all of our cash flow, which subjects us to greater risks than a gaming company with more operating properties.
We are a parent company and our primary source of cash is and will be distributions from our subsidiaries.
Our casino, hotel, convention and other facilities and offerings face intense competition, which may increase in the future.
Our business relies on premium customers. We often extend credit, and we may not be able to collect gaming receivables from our credit players or credit play may decrease.
Win rates for our gaming operations depend on a variety of factors, some of which are beyond our control.
We could encounter higher than expected cost increases in the development of our projects.
Because we own real property, we are subject to extensive environmental regulation, which creates uncertainty regarding future environmental expenditures and liabilities.
Adverse incidents or adverse publicity concerning our resorts or our corporate responsibilities could harm our brand and reputation and negatively impact our financial results.
Compliance with evolving laws and regulations, and the interpretations thereof, is expensive and results in compliance risks.
We are subject to taxation by various governments and agencies. The rate of taxation could change.
System failure, information leakage and the cost of maintaining sufficient cybersecurity could adversely affect our business.
Our business could suffer if our computer systems and websites are disrupted or cease to operate effectively.
If a third party successfully challenges our ownership of, or right to use, the Wynn-related trademarks and/or service marks, our business or results of operations could be harmed.
Labor actions and other labor problems could negatively impact our operations.
Our insurance coverage may not be adequate to cover all possible losses that we could suffer, including losses resulting from terrorism, and our insurance costs may increase.
Risks Associated with our Macau Operations
Our Macau Operations may be affected by adverse political and economic conditions.
We compete for limited labor resources in Macau and local policies may also affect our ability to employ imported labor.
The smoking control legislation in Macau could have an adverse effect on our business, financial condition, results of operations and cash flows.
Extreme weather conditions have had and may in the future have an adverse impact on our Macau Operations.
paragraphs: You should carefully consider the risk factors set forth below, as well as the other information contained in this Annual Report on Form 10-K, regarding matters that could have an adverse effect, including a material one, on our business, financial condition, results of operations and cash flows. Additional risks and uncertainties not currently known to us or that we currently deem to be immaterial may also have a material adverse effect on our business, financial condition, results of operations and cash flows.

Our business is particularly sensitive to reductions in discretionary consumer spending, and a negative macroeconomic environment, including an economic downturn or recession, could adversely impact our business, results of operations, financial condition and cash flows.

Our financial results are affected by the global and regional economies in which we have operations. Consumer demand for hotels, casino resorts, trade shows, conventions and the type of luxury amenities that we offer is particularly sensitive to downturns or perceived downturns in the economies in which we operate, which could harm consumer confidence in the economy and adversely affect discretionary spending. Because a significant number of our customers come from the PRC, Hong Kong and Taiwan, the economic condition of Macau and its surrounding region, in particular, affects the gaming industry in Macau and our Macau Operations. As a result, changes in discretionary spending or consumer preferences brought about by factors such as perceived or actual negative general economic conditions, perceived or actual changes in disposable consumer income and wealth, inflationary pressures, economic recession, or changes in consumer confidence could reduce customer demand for the luxury amenities and leisure activities we offer and may negatively impact our results of operations.

In the past, negative macroeconomic conditions, such as inflationary pressures, relatively low levels of unemployment, and increases in interest rates, caused decreases in consumer discretionary spending and disruption and volatility within the capital markets. Although the U.S. economy has shown a strong recovery, with GDP growth above pre-pandemic levels, the global economy is experiencing a slower recovery. In addition, lingering inflationary pressures, elevated interest rates (as compared to 2021 and the years prior to that) and ongoing geopolitical tensions, including a volatile global trade policy, remain significant risks to ongoing economic recovery and may present fiscal and monetary policy uncertainty or changes in such policy that could have a negative impact on consumer discretionary spending. As a result, our gaming revenues, financial condition, results of operations and cash flows could be adversely affected by a delay or stall in any economic recovery or, an economic slowdown or recession in the U.S. or global economy, or perception that any of these events may occur.

We are subject to extensive state and local regulation, and licensing and gaming authorities have significant control over our operations. The cost of compliance or failure to comply with such regulations and authorities could have a negative effect on our business, and if we fail to obtain regulatory approvals to operate in new jurisdictions, our growth prospects may be limited.

The operations of our resorts are contingent upon our obtaining and maintaining all necessary licenses, permits, approvals, registrations, findings of suitability, orders and authorizations in the jurisdictions in which our resorts are located. The laws, regulations and ordinances requiring these licenses, permits and other approvals generally relate to the responsibility, financial stability and character of the owners and managers of gaming operations, as well as persons financially interested or involved in gaming operations. The NGC may require the holder of any debt or securities that we, the registered intermediary subsidiaries, or Wynn Las Vegas, LLC issue to file applications, be investigated and be found suitable to own such debt or securities if it has reason to believe that the security ownership would be inconsistent with the declared policies of the State of Nevada. The NGC may also require anyone with a financial interest in a gaming establishment, or with a financial interest in the business of the gaming licensee or applicant for a gaming license or who is a close associate of a gaming licensee or an applicant for a gaming license, to be qualified for licensure.

We are a designer, developer, and operator of integrated resorts featuring luxury hotel rooms, high-end retail space, an array of dining and entertainment options, meeting and convention facilities, and gaming, all supported by an unparalleled focus on our guests, our people, and our community. Through our approximately 72% ownership of Wynn Macau, Limited ("WML"), our concessionaire Wynn Resorts (Macau) S.A. ("Wynn Macau SA") operates two integrated resorts in the Macau Special Administrative Region of the People's Republic of China ("Macau"), Wynn Palace and Wynn Macau (collectively, our "Macau Operations"). In Las Vegas, Nevada, we operate and, with the exception of certain retail space, own 100% of Wynn Las Vegas. We are a 50.1% owner and managing member of a joint venture that owns and leases certain retail space at Wynn Las Vegas (the "Retail Joint Venture"). We refer to Wynn Las Vegas, Encore, an expansion at Wynn Las Vegas, and the Retail Joint Venture as our Las Vegas Operations. In Everett, Massachusetts, we operate Encore Boston Harbor, an integrated resort.
The Company has a 40% equity interest in Island 3 AMI FZ-LLC ("Island 3"), an unconsolidated affiliate, which is constructing Wynn Al Marjan Island in Ras Al Khaimah, United Arab Emirates.

Certain key operating measures specific to the gaming industry are included in our discussion of our operational performance for the periods for which the Consolidated Statements of Income are presented. These key operating measures are presented as supplemental disclosures because management and/or certain investors use these measures to better understand period-over-period fluctuations in our casino and hotel operating revenues. These key operating measures are defined below:
•Table drop in mass market for our Macau Operations is the amount of cash that is deposited in a gaming table's drop box plus cash chips purchased at the casino cage.
•Table drop for our Las Vegas Operations is the amount of cash and net markers issued that are deposited in a gaming table's drop box.
•Table drop for Encore Boston Harbor is the amount of cash and gross markers issued that are deposited in a gaming table's drop box.
•Rolling chips are non-negotiable identifiable chips that are used to track turnover for purposes of calculating incentives within our Macau Operations' VIP program.
•Turnover is the sum of all losing rolling chip wagers within our Macau Operations' VIP program.

•Table games win is the amount of table drop or turnover that is retained and recorded as casino revenues. Table games win is before discounts, commissions and the allocation of casino revenues to rooms, food and beverage and other revenues for services provided to casino customers on a complimentary basis. Table games win does not include poker rake.

•Slot machine win is the amount of handle (representing the total amount wagered) that is retained by us and is recorded as casino revenues. Slot machine win is after adjustment for progressive accruals and free play, but before discounts and the allocation of casino revenues to rooms, food and beverage and other revenues for services provided to casino customers on a complimentary basis.

•Poker rake is the portion of cash wagered by patrons in our poker rooms that is retained by the casino as a service fee, after adjustment for progressive accruals, but before the allocation of casino revenues to rooms, food and beverage and other revenues for services provided to casino customers on a complimentary basis. Poker tables are not included in our measure of average number of table games.
•Average daily rate ("ADR") is calculated by dividing total room revenues, including complimentaries (less service charges, if any), by total rooms occupied.

Wynn Resorts, Limited ("Wynn Resorts," "Wynn," 或合稱其子公司為 "we" 或 "the Company") 是一家在整合式度假村領域中備受推崇的設計、開發與營運者，提供豪華飯店客房、高檔零售空間、多樣化的餐飲與娛樂選擇、會議與展覽設施，以及賭博服務，並以無與倫比的重視程度著力於我們的顧客、員工與社區。我們相信，我們在多個賭博司法管轄區的設計與營運經驗，使我們在其他賭博企業中擁有獨特優勢。

透過我們約 72% 的持股比例擁有 Wynn Macau, Limited ("WML")，我們在中華人民共和國澳門特別行政區 ("澳門") 運營兩座整合式度假村，即 Wynn Palace 與 Wynn Macau (合稱為 "澳門營運")。在美國內華達州拉斯維加斯，我們運營並（除部分零售空間外）擁有 100% 的 Wynn Las Vegas 與 Encore at Wynn Las Vegas，我們也稱之為 "拉斯維加斯營運"。在美國馬薩諸塞州埃弗雷特，我們運營 Encore Boston Harbor，一座整合式度假村。此外，本公司持有 Island 3 AMI FZ-LLC 40% 的權益，該公司為未合併附屬公司，正在阿拉伯聯合大公國拉希德 (Ras Al Khaimah) 建設一座整合式度假村 ("Wynn Al Marjan Island")，預計於 2027 年開幕。

本公司於 Form 10-K 的年度報告、Form 10-Q 的季度報告、Form 8-K 的現況報告，以及所有其他報告與相關修正案，均免費提供於美國證券交易委員會 ("SEC") 的網站 http://www.sec.gov。此外，透過本公司網站 www.wynnresorts.com，Wynn Resorts 提供一個超連結至第三方 SEC 報告網站，該網站會在報告提交或提供給 SEC 後盡可能迅速免費提供所有報告與修正案。本網站或連結至本網站的資訊並未納入本年度 Form 10-K 報告中，亦不構成本年度 Form 10-K 報告或其他提交或提供給 SEC 的報告的一部分。
我們從概念規劃、設計、建設與營運度假村，以創造難忘的客戶體驗，涵蓋多樣化的賭博與非賭博設施，吸引廣泛的客戶羣體，並產生強勁的財務表現。

我們策略的核心是建設與持續投資世界級的整合式度假村。這些活動由我們內部的設計、開發與建設子公司及其高階管理團隊領導，該團隊在所有主要設計與建設領域均有豐富經驗。此外，我們認為優越的客戶服務是最有效的行銷策略，以吸引客戶並提高客戶重訪率。人力資源與員工培訓對確保員工能提供顧客所期待的豪華服務至關重要。我們成功吸引廣泛的高階客戶羣，無論是國內還是國際。這部分策略包括利用我們的行銷團隊在國際各分支辦公室，與客戶建立聯繫並培養關係。我們持續評估我們的產品與服務水準，因此已做出並預期持續做出對度假村的改進與優化。
我們持續尋找在全球開發與營運世界級整合式度假村及相關業務的新機會。總體而言，我們相信 Wynn Resorts 有顯著的紀錄，成功開發與營運整合式度假村，刺激當地與區域經濟活動，透過吸引廣泛的客戶羣（包括高淨值國際旅客），推動國際旅遊，提高地區平均飯店房間價格，延長每位旅客的停留時間，以五星級住宿與適當規模的會議設施補強現有的會議與展覽業務，執行五星級客戶服務，並刺激全市的投資與就業。
Wynn Resorts 能在豪華旅遊業中成功運作，是因為我們的員工，他們在公司內各層級展現我們的價值觀。我們的價值觀體現在以下概念：
•服務導向。我們培養一種尊重、感恩與細緻關注的氛圍，使服務顧客成為我們的畢生使命。
•卓越。我們專注於成為最好的，體現員工與旅客、公司與社區之間內在的連結。
•藝術性。我們提供一系列旅客體驗，重視藝術性與冠軍級工藝，使永利度假村成為全球排名最高的酒店公司。
•進步。我們對創新承諾，使我們能持續進化，創造與營運世界級度假勝地的意義。
我們對企業社會責任的承諾
我們致力於我們的員工、社區與地球。落實我們對企業社會責任的承諾包括：
•投資於我們員工的成長與福祉。

本公司為整合度假村之設計、開發及營運者，提供豪華客房、高檔零售空間、多樣化餐飲與娛樂選擇、會議與展覽設施，以及賭博服務，並以無與倫比的關注度服務旅客、員工及社區。透過本公司約 72% 之股權擁有 Wynn Macau, Limited（"WML"），本公司之特許經營商 Wynn Resorts (Macau) S.A.（"Wynn Macau SA"）於中華人民共和國澳門特別行政區（"澳門"）經營兩座整合度假村，即 Wynn Palace 及 Wynn Macau（合稱為本公司之 "澳門營運"）。於美國內華達州拉斯維加斯，本公司經營並除部分零售空間外，擁有 100% 之 Wynn Las Vegas。本公司為一合資企業之 50.1% 股東及管理成員，該合資企業擁有並出租 Wynn Las Vegas 之部分零售空間（"零售合資企業"）。本公司將 Wynn Las Vegas、Encore、Wynn Las Vegas 之擴張項目以及零售合資企業稱為拉斯維加斯營運。於馬薩諸塞州埃弗雷特，本公司經營 Encore Boston Harbor 整合度假村。
本公司於 Island 3 AMI FZ-LLC（"Island 3"），一未合併附屬公司，擁有 40% 之權益，該公司正在阿拉伯聯合大公國拉希亞（Ras Al Khaimah）建造 Wynn Al Marjan Island。
某些特定於賭博產業之關鍵營運指標已包含於本公司對營運表現之討論中，該討論針對合併損益表所列示之期間。這些關鍵營運指標以補充披露方式呈現，因管理層及/或部分投資者使用這些指標以更清楚瞭解本公司賭場及飯店營運收入之期與期之間變動。這些關鍵營運指標之定義如下：
•本公司澳門營運之大眾市場桌賭金為存入賭桌提款箱之現金金額加上在賭場金庫購買之現金籌碼。
•本公司拉斯維加斯營運之桌賭金為存入賭桌提款箱之現金及淨籌碼金額。
•Encore Boston Harbor 之桌賭金為存入賭桌提款箱之現金及毛籌碼金額。
•Rolling chips 是非可議的可識別零組件，用於追蹤轉帳以計算本公司澳門營運之 VIP 程式之獎金。
•轉帳係指本公司澳門營運之 VIP 程式內所有賠負之 rolling chip 投注總額。
•桌上遊戲獲利係指桌上遊戲之投注或轉帳中，本公司所保留並記錄為賭場收入之金額。桌上遊戲獲利為扣除折扣、佣金及賭場收入分配至客房、餐飲及其他服務收入前之金額，且不包含德州撲克抽水。
•機臺遊戲獲利係指本公司所保留並記錄為賭場收入之總投注金額。機臺遊戲獲利為扣除進步賠率累計及免費投注後之金額，但扣除折扣及賭場收入分配至客房、餐飲及其他服務收入前之金額。
•德州撲克抽水係指本公司在德州撲克房間中，扣除進步賠率累計後，由玩家投注金額中保留作為服務費之部分，但扣除賭場收入分配至客房、餐飲及其他服務收入前之金額。德州撲克桌不包含於本公司之平均桌上遊戲數量計算中。
•平均每日房價（"ADR"）係以總客房收入（包含免費住宿，扣除服務費，如有）除以總客房佔用數計算得出。

headings: 與我們業務相關的風險
調查、訴訟及其他爭議可能分散管理層的注意力，損害我們的聲譽，並導致負面宣傳及來自監管機構的更多審查。
我們依賴關鍵管理人員和員工的持續服務。如果我們無法留住關鍵人員或吸引並留住其他高技能員工，將會對我們的業務造成影響。
我們的持續成功取決於我們維護度假村聲譽的能力。
我們完全依賴有限數量的度假村來產生所有現金流，這使我們面臨比擁有更多運營場地的賭場公司更高的風險。
我們是母公司，我們的主要現金來源是並將持續來自子公司的分紅。
我們的賭場、酒店、會議及其他設施和服務面臨激烈競爭，這種競爭可能在未來進一步增加。
我們的業務依賴高消費客羣。我們經常提供信用貸款，我們可能無法從信用玩家那裡收回賭場應收款，或信用投注可能減少。
本公司賭場營運的獲利率取決於許多因素，其中一些因素超出本公司控制範圍。
本公司在開發專案時，可能遭遇高於預期的成本增加。
由於本公司擁有實物資產，因此需面對嚴格的環境法規，這會造成未來環境支出及負債的不確定性。
有關本公司度假村或公司責任的不利事件或不利宣傳，可能損害本公司品牌與聲譽，並對財務結果產生負面影響。
遵守不斷演變的法律與法規及其解釋，成本高昂且會產生合規風險。
本公司需接受各政府與機構的稅收，稅率可能發生變動。
系統故障、資訊外洩及維護足夠網路安全的成本，可能對本公司業務產生不利影響。
若本公司電腦系統及網站遭中斷或無法有效運作，業務可能受到影響。
若第三方成功挑戰本公司對Wynn相關商標及服務標誌的所有權或使用權，將可能對本公司業務或營運成果造成損害。
勞動行動及其他勞動問題可能對本公司營運造成負面影響。
本公司保險覆蓋範圍可能無法充分彌補所有可能遭受的損失，包括因恐怖攻擊所致損失，且保險費用可能增加。
與本公司澳門營運相關的風險
本公司澳門營運可能受不利的政治及經濟環境影響。
本公司在澳門競爭有限的勞動資源，且當地政策可能影響本公司聘僱進口勞動力的能力。
澳門的禁煙立法可能對本公司業務、財務狀況、營運成果及現金流造成負面影響。
極端天氣情況已對本公司澳門營運造成影響，並可能在未來繼續造成負面影響。
paragraphs: 您應謹慎考量下列所列之風險因素，以及本年度報告表10-K中其他資訊，關於可能對我們之業務、財務狀況、營運結果及現金流產生不利影響，包括重大影響之事項。此外，尚有其他風險與不確定性，目前尚未為我們所知，或目前認為不重要，亦可能對我們之業務、財務狀況、營運結果及現金流產生重大不利影響。
我們之業務特別敏感於可支配消費者支出之減少，以及負面總體經濟環境，包括經濟衰退或蕭條，可能對我們之業務、營運結果、財務狀況及現金流產生不利影響。

我們之財務結果受我們營運之全球及區域經濟影響。消費者對飯店、賭場度假村、展覽會、會議及我們所提供的豪華設施類型之需求，特別敏感於我們營運之經濟體之衰退或被認為之衰退，這可能會影響消費者對經濟之信心，並對可支配支出產生不利影響。由於我們許多客戶來自中國大陸、香港及臺灣，因此澳門及其周邊地區之經濟狀況，特別影響澳門之賭博產業及我們之澳門營運。因此，因應總體經濟狀況被認為或實際為負面、可支配消費者所得與財富被認為或實際改變、通貨膨脹壓力、經濟衰退，或消費者信心改變等因素所導致之可支配支出或消費者偏好改變，可能會減少消費者對我們所提供的豪華設施及休閒活動之需求，並可能對我們之營運結果產生負面影響。

過去，負面總體經濟條件，例如通貨膨脹壓力、相對低失業率，以及利率上升，導致消費者可支配支出減少，並造成資本市場之動盪與波動。儘管美國經濟已顯示強勁復甦，GDP成長高於疫情前水準，但全球經濟正經歷較慢之復甦。此外，持續的通貨膨脹壓力、較高利率（相較於2021年及之前年份）以及持續的國際政治緊張，包括不穩定的全球貿易政策，仍是持續經濟復甦之重大風險，並可能造成財政與貨幣政策之不確定性或政策改變，這可能會對消費者可支配支出產生負面影響。因此，我們之賭博收入、財務狀況、營運結果及現金流可能因任何經濟復甦之延遲或停滯，或美國或全球經濟之經濟放緩或衰退，或認為這些事件可能發生，而受到不利影響。
我們受廣泛之州及地方規範所制約，並且執照與賭博主管機關對我們之營運有重大控制權。遵守這些規範或主管機關之成本，或未能遵守這些規範或主管機關，可能對我們之業務產生負面影響，若我們未能取得在新管轄區營運之執照核准，我們之成長前景可能受到限制。

我們之度假村營運依賴於取得並維持所有必要之執照、許可、核准、登記、適合性評估、命令及核准，這些執照、許可及其他核准係在我們度假村所在地之管轄區取得。這些執照、許可及其它核准之法律、規範與條例通常與經營賭博業務之所有者與經理人之責任、財務穩定性與個人品行有關，以及與財務上利益相關或參與賭博業務之人有關。NGC可能要求持有我們、註冊中介子公司或Wynn Las Vegas, LLC所發行之債務或證券之人，必須提出申請、接受調查並被認為適合擁有該債務或證券，如果NGC認為該證券擁有權與內華達州之政策不一致。NGC也可能要求任何對賭場設施有財務利益之人，或對賭博許可證持有人或申請賭博許可證之業務有財務利益之人，或為賭博許可證持有人或申請賭命證之人的密切關係之人，必須符合執照核准之條件。
